# Navimower Map Card 0.3.1-beta6

0.3.1-beta6 removes the accumulated version-specific JavaScript loader chain and makes the current beta runtime a single cumulative source/distribution pair.

## One runtime file

The active runtime layout is now intentionally only:

```text
src/navimower-map-card.js
dist/navimower-map-card.js
```

The previous 0.2.2 core plus 0.3.x patch-layer chain was bundled once into the new cumulative source. Before the migration, the complete 0.3.1-beta5 test suite was run against the old layered runtime. After bundling, the generated single-file runtime passed syntax, layout and runtime smoke checks before it was committed.

`dist/navimower-map-card.js` is now an exact copy produced from `src/navimower-map-card.js`; it is no longer a directory full of historical loaders and compatibility modules.

## Preventing the problem from returning

- `scripts/build.mjs` refuses to build if `src/` contains any second JavaScript runtime file.
- Every build removes and recreates `dist/`, so obsolete generated files cannot silently survive there.
- `scripts/check-runtime-layout.mjs` requires exactly one JavaScript file in both `src/` and `dist/`, requires source/distribution byte-for-byte parity, and rejects version-specific local loader imports.
- The same architecture rule and its explicit exception process are documented in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- If a future technical requirement genuinely needs multiple runtime files, the build/layout guard, tests and documentation must be changed deliberately in the same change. A new beta or cache-busting workaround alone is not a reason to bypass the guard.

## Cumulative beta workflow stays the same

The cleanup does **not** change the cumulative release model. Each beta continues from the complete previous beta implementation in `src/navimower-map-card.js`. Git commits, tags and GitHub releases retain historical versions; historical beta code no longer needs to remain as runtime files on `main`.

Stable 0.3.1 can therefore still be made from the final tested beta with only the intended stable-version/documentation cleanup. There is no later merge step that has to combine beta1, beta2, beta3, and so on.

Automatic beta/stable publishing is now version-bump driven: normal source, test and documentation commits can land first, and changing `package.json` is the final release trigger.

## Stable HACS filename

HACS now uses the stable runtime filename `navimower-map-card.js` for prereleases and stable releases. Cache safety is no longer implemented by creating a new JavaScript filename and loader for each beta.

## Compatibility

- Existing card YAML, entity discovery, map/history rendering, Notifications, Schedule, Mow/Pause/Dock, and beta5 Resume behavior are retained in the flattened runtime.
- Beta6 regression checks explicitly verify that key map cache/daily-trail, VF-off, notification read, and Resume markers survived the flattening.
- 0.3.1-beta6 is cumulative from beta1 through beta5; earlier 0.3.1 betas do not need to be installed first.
